I replied to Tobias in your DM to confirm that Dock 26 is now their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Heron project.

I don't have a memory store I can save things to. The note exists only as this DM, which I can look back at if they ask later. I told them that, and said I'd keep it private to them. I also suggested they tell anyone else who needs to know about the change themselves. I didn't take any other action.
